dot.name: DoT
dot.description: Deals damage each tick, before normal spells (including effects just applied by an Instant). Loses 1 stack each tick. Reapplying adds duration, not per-tick power.

hot.name: HoT
hot.description: Heals during the HoT phase, then loses 1 stack. Reapplying adds stacks. Most HoTs heal a fixed amount; Lifebloom heals per remaining stack.

instant.name: Instant
instant.description: Resolves at tick start, before damage over time and duration countdowns. Your next spell waits until the next tick.

crit.name: Crit
crit.description: A critical hit deals 150% of normal damage.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: X is the number of identical Channel cards in a consecutive group in your hand. Each copy casts separately at its listed time and mana cost. Groups do not wrap across the ends of the hand.

unique.name: Unique
unique.description: Only one copy of this spell may be in your deck, across base and upgraded versions. Shop copies can still be consumed directly for upgrade XP.

moonfire.name: Moonfire
moonfire.description: A DoT that deals 10 damage per tick.

sunfire.name: Sunfire
sunfire.description: A DoT that deals 20 damage per tick.

lifebloom.name: Lifebloom
lifebloom.description: Heals 10 health per remaining stack each tick, then loses 1 stack. At 5 stacks, heals 50; next tick at 4 stacks, heals 40. Reapplying adds stacks.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: A HoT that heals 10 health per tick.

slowness.name: Slowness
slowness.description: The next spell takes 1 extra tick to cast.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: A DoT that deals 50 damage per tick.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: Take 10 damage each time you begin casting a spell while active, including Instant spells. Skips and continued casting do not trigger it. Loses 1 stack each tick.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.description: Your Growth heals 30 health per tick instead of 10 while active. Does not change Lifebloom or the opponent’s Growth. Loses 1 stack each tick.

tide.name: Tide
tide.description: Grants a 20% chance to trigger Tidecaller. A double cast consumes up to 5 Tide stacks. Maelstrom prevents countdown, but not consumption.

tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.description: When triggered, the spell resolves twice.

steal.name: Steal
steal.description: Take mana from the opponent and gain it yourself.

veil.name: Veil
veil.description: Take 50% less damage. Restore 5 mana each time an opposing spell hits you; periodic damage does not grant mana.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Immune to all damage while active. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration; taking damage does not consume stacks.

hotstreak.name: Hotstreak
hotstreak.description: Each stack grants 10% crit chance (up to 100%) and loses 1 stack per tick. Crossing from below 5 to at least 5 stacks grants 3 Combust. Hotstreak is not consumed.

combust.name: Combust
combust.description: While active, spells take at most 1 tick; Instant stays Instant. Each completed spell deals 5 damage to you. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Deal 10 damage per remaining Burn stack each tick, then remove 1 stack. For example, 5 stacks deal 50, then 40, 30, 20 and 10 damage.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.description: Your DoTs can critically hit using your crit chance at the start of each tick.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.description: While active, your critical hits deal 200% of normal damage instead of 150%. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Stop the current cast or channel and skip that card. Mana already spent is not refunded. Completed casts are unaffected.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: On death while active, revive with half maximum health and mana. Each stack adds 1 tick of duration. Rebirth does not consume the remaining duration.

celestial-alignment.name: Celestial Alignment
celestial-alignment.description: Your next started spell deals double direct damage. Consumed when casting starts; the bonus lasts through that cast. Does not boost later DoT ticks. Unused stacks count down each tick.

greater-alignment.name: Greater Alignment
greater-alignment.description: Your next started spell deals triple direct damage. Consumed when casting starts; the bonus lasts through that cast. Does not boost later DoT ticks. Unused stacks count down each tick.

cloud-heart.name: Cloud Heart
cloud-heart.description: Receive 40% more healing while active (60% for Greater Cloud Heart). Lasts 25 ticks; includes healing over time.

greater-cloud-heart.name: Greater Cloud Heart
greater-cloud-heart.description: Receive 60% more healing while active, including healing over time. Lasts 25 ticks.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: A damage shield. Each point absorbs 1 damage before Health is lost, then is consumed. Ward adds together and does not count down; it resets each combat. Guard prevents damage without spending Ward.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: One pass through your ordered spell deck, ending after its Reshuffle. Once-per-Cycle equipment refreshes for the next pass. Skipped and interrupted cards still advance the deck.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: Increases healing you do by the stated percentage, including healing over time. Does not increase Mana restoration. Healing received bonuses are separate.

spell-power.name: Spell Power
spell-power.description: Increases direct spell damage by the stated percentage. Damage over time needs a DoT damage bonus unless an item explicitly says otherwise.

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.description: Persistent enemy stacks. Every 5 are consumed to add +1 Penance tick to their next reshuffle, without a cap. Cleanse removes only unconverted stacks.

penance.name: Penance
penance.description: Extra reshuffle ticks. Damage, healing and timed effects continue normally. Penance gained during a reshuffle waits for the next one.

oath.name: Oath
oath.description: One active Oath. Meet its condition for a reward; a new Oath replaces it. Its own cast is excluded. Repeated triggers count as one completed card.

retribution.name: Retribution
retribution.description: After an opposing direct spell damages your Health, retaliate for 15 damage, at most once per tick. DoTs, absorbed hits and retaliation do not trigger it.

templars-oath.name: Templar's Oath
templars-oath.description: A timed stance: take 20% less damage and deal 10% less direct spell damage. Does not replace a condition-based Oath.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: Take 40% less damage and receive 25% more healing while active.

holy-ground.name: Holy Ground
holy-ground.description: Heal 15 each tick. Apply 1 Consecration whenever the opponent starts a new spell while active.

citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.description: Take 30% less damage. Each opposing direct spell hit that damages your Health applies 1 Consecration to its caster.
